Rejected Terra's accurately_unavailable reconciliation for boneless bites and tenders insofar as it demotes soy entirely to may-contain. Rejected Terra's unavailable-allergen treatment for Hot Honey Pepperoni insofar as the restaurant-linked description explicitly names cheese; that supports at least a narrow milk positive, not a complete array.
